metadata.description: Source-verified Claude Code skills for the Viam robotics platform. Install the full suite or pick individual SDKs and tools.

plugins.name: viam-skills
plugins.description: Full Viam skill suite — all 9 skills: SDKs, ML, fleet/module tooling, and machine tooling.

plugins.name: viam-go-motion-vision
plugins.description: Go SDK: arm, camera, vision, motion planning, frame system.

plugins.name: viam-go-platform
plugins.description: Go SDK: non-manipulation components, services, resource API.

plugins.name: viam-modules-fleet
plugins.description: Viam CLI, module lifecycle, registry, fleet and robot configuration.

plugins.name: viam-python
plugins.description: Python SDK: async clients, components/services, module dev.

plugins.name: viam-ml
plugins.description: Data capture, training, and model deployment (TFLite, Triton, ONNX).

plugins.name: viam-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript SDK: browser robot control, Viam Applications, HMIs.

plugins.name: local-viam-server
plugins.description: Create a Viam cloud machine and run a local viam-server connected to it.

plugins.name: viam-machine-config
plugins.description: Push or replace a Viam machine's robot config via the Viam app API.
